description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_3DPrint"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/custom-3d-model-print">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Draft" name="3D model draft (STL)"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChangeRequest" name="Change request"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DPrint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Sketches" sourceRef="SendTask_Sketches" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Draft" name="3D model draft" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ChangeRequest" name="Change request" sourceRef="SendTask_ChangeRequest" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist to create a 3D model and print it" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedModel" name="Custom model needed"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Sketches" name="Send sketches to artist" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Revision_Merge" name="Merge revision loop"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Draft" name="Receive 3D model draft" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied_Split" name="Satisfied with result?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ChangeRequest" name="Tell artist what to change" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InStock_Split" name="Color in stock?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAmount" name="Check how much plastic is left"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Amount_Split" name="Remaining amount" default="Flow_AmountOk"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Put plastic on shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderPlastic" name="Order plastic"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Plastic_Merge" name="Plastic available"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prepare_Split" name="Prepare printing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatPrinter" name="Turn on printer and heat bed and extruder"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate G-code from STL"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prepare_Join" name="Printer ready and G-code generated"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ModelPrinted" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Sketches" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedModel" targetRef="SendTask_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sketches_Merge" sourceRef="SendTask_Sketches" targetRef="Gateway_Revision_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Draft" sourceRef="Gateway_Revision_Merge" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Draft_Satisfied" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Draft" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfied_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Split" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${satisfied}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfied_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Split" targetRef="SendTask_ChangeRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!satisfied}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Changes_Merge" sourceRef="SendTask_ChangeRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Revision_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Color_InStockSplit" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_InStock_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${inStock}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock_Split" targetRef="Task_OrderPlastic">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!inStock}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_AmountSplit" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Amount_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Amount_Under100" name="Under 100 g" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount_Split" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${remainingGrams < 100}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AmountOk" name="100 g or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shopping_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Merge" sourceRef="Task_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Plastic_Prepare" sourceRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Prepare_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Heat" sourceRef="Gateway_Prepare_Split" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_GCode" sourceRef="Gateway_Prepare_Split" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Heat_Join" sourceRef="Task_HeatPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_Prepare_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GCode_Join" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_Prepare_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Print" sourceRef="Gateway_Prepare_Join" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Print_End" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="EndEvent_ModelPrinted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
